mapper.select: SELECT ba.id, ba.ask_no , ba.ask_date , bah.id as ask_history_id, bah.status , sdd.dict_label as status_label, su.nick_name AS answer_user, mac1.category_name AS category1, mac2.category_name AS category2, TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(bah.answer_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS answer_time, bah.ask_answer_remark FROM bss_ask AS ba INNER JOIN bss_ask_history bah ON bah.ask_id = ba.id LEFT JOIN mast_ask_category mac1 ON mac1.category_id = bah.category1 AND mac1.discontinued_flg = '0' LEFT JOIN mast_ask_category mac2 ON mac2.category_id = bah.category2 AND mac2.discontinued_flg = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_name = bah.answer_user LEFT join sys_dict_data sdd ON bah.status = sdd.dict_value AND sdd.dict_type = 'bss_ask_status' WHERE ba.order_id = #{orderId} and ba.farmer_id = #{farmerId} ORDER BY ba.ask_date DESC, ba.create_time DESC, bah.seq_no desc
